summary.name: Zarla
summary.one_liner: Zarla is an AI website builder that generates a finished small-business website, with copy, photos and SEO setup, from a one-sentence description of the business.
use_cases: Build a website for a local trade business
Create a booking page for appointments
Set up local SEO for a small business
Send quotes and invoices to customers
Track website enquiries in one inbox
Build a portfolio or personal brand site
summary.what_it_does: Zarla takes a short description of a business (name, what it does, location) and generates a website with pages, written copy, photos and search settings, which the page says takes about 30 seconds. Users change the site afterwards by typing requests in plain English. The page says it includes a lead/CRM pipeline, online booking, quotes and invoices, and a Google account connection that reports search and Google Business Profile data. It also says it checks how ChatGPT and Google's AI describe the business. Building and previewing is free; publishing requires a paid plan.
notable: Generates copy, photos and SEO settings from one sentence about the business
Edit the site by chatting in plain English, including from a phone
Built-in lead pipeline, online booking, quotes and invoices
Can import an existing site URL or use another site's design direction
caveats: Paid plan required to publish, from $10.99/mo on the page's 36-month plan
Builds business websites only, not web apps with logins, databases or SaaS products
Site itself cannot be exported; only contacts can be downloaded
Does not know real prices, hours or photos, so these must be added before publishing; no guaranteed Google ranking
